items.title: Tonight's supermoon: why the moon looks so big
items.description:
Tonight (24 Nov 2026, Kartik Purnima) the full moon is a supermoon, about 360,768 km away, exact full moon at 8:23 pm IST. It really is a little closer and brighter, but the giant look near the horizon is a trick of our brain.
Sources: Star Walk 12 Nov 2026 https://starwalk.space/en/news/full-moon-november-2022

items.title: One Fish for ₹30 Crore? The Real Reason Is Advertising
items.description:
Every January, Tokyo's Toyosu market holds the first tuna auction of the year. In 2026 one bluefin sold for 510.3 million yen (about ₹30 crore). The buyer, a sushi chain owner, gets free worldwide news coverage, then sells the fish at normal prices and takes the loss. Rate: 1 yen = ₹0.5866 (21 Nov 2026).
Sources: nippon.com https://www.nippon.com/en/guide-to-japan/gu900316/
NBC News/AP https://www.nbcnews.com/world/asia/bluefin-tuna-sells-record-32-million-auction-tokyo-fish-market-rcna252288
